annotations.title: Overtime pay calculator (FLSA + CA/AK/CO daily rules)

description: Overtime pay calculator (FLSA + CA/AK/CO daily rules) — Offline overtime and gross-pay calculator for non-exempt workers. Give rate= (hourly) and days= (daily hours in workweek order) or hours= (weekly total). Applies the federal FLSA 40-hour weekly rule plus state daily rules for California (over 8 = 1.5x, over 12 = 2x, 7th consecutive day), Alaska (over 8) and Colorado (over 12). Optional bonus= folds a nondiscretionary bonus into the regular rate per 29 CFR 778.209. Returns regular/OT/double-time hours per day, regular rate, premiums and gross pay. Params: rate, days or hours, state (CA|AK|CO|NV|US), bonus. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_overtime
